name: Linked Art (Getty)
description: Re-models multimodal annotations under the Getty's Linked Art profile (a CIDOC-CRM subset). The three GEKO ekphrastic modalities (denotation / dynamization / integration) are preserved BUT expressed in the LA-idiomatic way: as `classified_as` on the LinguisticObject, NOT as a custom predicate. Demonstrates pluggability — same annotation core, different ontology, same concept re-cast in the target idiom.

entityClasses.label: Human-Made Object
entityClasses.description: Physical artwork (painting, sculpture, print). LA's top class for the iconic referent.

entityClasses.label: Visual Item
entityClasses.description: The visual content carried by a Human-Made Object — distinct from the physical object itself.

entityClasses.label: Linguistic Object
entityClasses.description: A textual content unit — used here for the text excerpt of each annotation.

entityClasses.label: Digital Object
entityClasses.description: A digital representation (e.g. a IIIF image) of a Visual Item.

linkingProperties.label: Denotation
linkingProperties.description: Direct referential link — expressed as classified_as on the LinguisticObject in this profile.

linkingProperties.label: Dynamization
linkingProperties.description: Temporal / movement-based ekphrastic link — expressed as classified_as on the LinguisticObject in this profile.

linkingProperties.label: Integration
linkingProperties.description: Interpretive ekphrastic blend — expressed as classified_as on the LinguisticObject in this profile.

notes.pattern_for_modality: MODE B (classified_as on LinguisticObject). Linked Art has no built-in pattern to type a relationship between entities (no AttributeAssignment / Relationship reification recommended), so the modality classifies the text fragment itself. Source: linked.art/model/base — `classified_as` is always a property OF an entity, never of a link.
notes.region_granularity: Linked Art has no native xywh/region selector (verified against linked.art/model/digital and linked.art/api/1.0/shared/digital). This profile's export drops per-region xywh and keeps granularity at the canvas / HumanMadeObject level. Region information remains available in the GEKO native export and the IIIF manifest export.
